reading.title: AI staff 'genuinely frightened' for humanity's future, ex-Anthropic researcher tells BBC
reading.summary: It comes as the AI firm's boss has called for the technology's development to be slowed down, citing "serious" risks.

news.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
news.summary: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.
